ask-yes-no.text: Lamp, ask me a quick yes or no question.

followup-sunset.text: So why does it turn orange at sunset?

self-correction.text: Lamp, what's twelve divided by, sorry, twelve times three?

rapid-question.text: Lamp, quick one, how many minutes are there in three and a half hours?
